Juliet Sotnick
Biography
Juliet brings over 25 years’ commercial and sustainability experience. Her career included roles as Chief Procurement & Supply Chain Officer and Chief Sustainability Officer at Babcock International, Group Head of Procurement at Sky plc., and Managing Director at Bear Stearns & Co., New York, USA.
Juliet holds an MBA from New York University and completed the Executive Education for Sustainability Leadership programme at Harvard University. She is an accredited executive coach and holds the following Non-Executive roles:
- Exchange for Change, the UK’s deposit return scheme, where she is chair of the Fees Committee and chair of the IT & Operations Committee.
- The Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply: Chair of the Audit Committee and the Foundation Committee.
